_meta.purpose: Deterministic ADC Miss Fortune SR oracle for the in-game build module (B2 3-row scaffold + B3 owned-greying) and the C2 scoring model (core/build_planner/scoring). ASCII-only (repo hard rule). Consumed by tests/test_overlay_b4_mf_sr_fixture.py - there is NO JS test runner, so a Python test is the consumer.

meta_build.note: Marksman-correct path. MF DEFAULT archetype resolves to assassin (burst scorer), so archetype=carry MUST be passed explicitly to reach this build. delta_dps here is the per-slot incremental display delta the build module renders (a different basis than scoring_oracle.seed_rows).

alt_assassin_build.source: /api/build-order {champion: MissFortune, archetype: assassin OR default, mode: sr}
alt_assassin_build.note: The MF DEFAULT (no-archetype) build, identical to archetype=assassin. Anchors the archetype-routing gotcha: it differs from the marksman meta build by its lethality boots (3173 Chainlaced Crushers) + Essence Reaver (3508), and lacks the carry boots (3172) + Yun Tal (3032). The build module must request archetype=carry to override this default.

live_deviation.note: Live-row deviation vs a heavy-heal enemy comp: the planner inserts an early antiheal component (Executioner's Calling) ahead of the standard slot, completing into Mortal Reminder. Mirrors the core/build_planner/situational antiheal counter-build criterion.
live_deviation.recipe_check: 3123 is a direct component of 3033 (verified vs /api/dictionary/items: 3033.from includes 3123)

scoring_oracle.note: C2 score_build (core/build_planner/scoring) must rank the kit-appropriate marksman build far above an off-archetype AP build for MissFortune. The margin is robust (NOT fixture-shaped): the AP build scores negative on kit anti-synergy and zero DPS, while the marksman build carries real DS deltas + positive kit synergy. Live-measured 2026-06-29: marksman total ~1.499 vs AP ~-0.038.
scoring_oracle.source: /api/ds-preview {champion: MissFortune, archetype: carry, mode: sr} ranked[] (DPS scorer, top=8) + boots/LDR rows at delta_dps 0

knob_defaults.note: DS fight-model knob defaults for an ADC (MF) vs the example enemy comp - the Row3 knob placeholders the build module shows (auto 95 / auto 63 from the SR mode-level curve at level 11).
